overview_description.description: The Wealth Karma is a Dubai-based fintech and financial wellness platform focused on helping expats in the GCC region improve financial literacy, retirement planning, and long-term wealth management. The platform provides personalized financial education through bite-sized learning modules, assessments, digital tools, and access to financial advisors.

product.name: Personalized Financial Assessment
product.description: A quick assessment tool that evaluates an individual's financial knowledge and retirement planning readiness to provide a tailored financial learning path.

product.name: Bite-Sized Financial Education Modules
product.description: Short educational modules that cover fundamental financial topics to improve users' understanding of retirement planning and investment concepts.

product.name: Retirement Planning Guidance and Tools
product.description: Digital tools and resources that assist expats in creating and managing personalized retirement plans tailored to their unique circumstances.

identifier.value: Financial Wellness and Risk Management Resources

product.name: Financial Wellness and Risk Management Resources
product.description: Educational content and strategies focused on managing financial risks such as debt, emergencies, and market volatility to maintain financial stability.

product.name: Shariah-Compliant Investment Education
product.description: Educational content explaining investment options that comply with Islamic principles, tailored for expats seeking halal financial growth opportunities.
